novelty_flags.label: Theorem 1 / related_work
novelty_flags.one_line: Koyama2025, Coarse-Grained Hawkes Processes, is a closer published fixed-bin second-order comparator and must be added and distinguished from the exact two-lag claim.

novelty_flags.label: Theorem 1 seed anchor
novelty_flags.one_line: The flagship seed names comparator bibkeys but supplies no paper section, theorem, equation, or quoted open-problem locator tying the full-observable requirements to the claimed two-lag gap.

soundness_flags.label: Theorem 3 and Theorem 4
soundness_flags.one_line: Omega is defined for raw Y=(X,vec(X_{k+1}X_kᵀ),vec(X_{k+2}X_kᵀ)), whereas Phi is a map of centered covariances; the stated DΦ Omega DΦᵀ omits the centering-map Jacobian, so the asserted covariance and graph-set calibration are not defined as written.

soundness_flags.label: Open-ended Question 1
soundness_flags.one_line: “Relatively open rank stratum” and the compatibility fiber lack a specified parameter/law topology and fiber map, so the requested necessary-and-sufficient criterion is not yet a determinate target.

soundness_flags.label: Open-ended Question 2
soundness_flags.one_line: Expected graph-inclusion loss, parameter diameter, and the comparison class for a “sharp unavoidable price” are undefined, leaving the OEQ without a well-defined minimax target.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorem 1 — two-lag exact recovery
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The result is conditional on the stationary labeled, nonnegative, zero-diagonal DAG Hawkes model with one common exponential decay and known fixed bin width.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Exact recovery of (beta,A,mu) from (m,Gamma_1,Gamma_2) only within the stated acyclic common-decay model class; this is a legitimate regime restriction, not an assumed inverse.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorems 3–4
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Uniform Gaussian inference is restricted to fixed p and the explicit fixed-margin class; rank-boundary and empty-network adaptation remain open.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Uniform asymptotic inference only over Mmargin, with honest adaptation over Mbar reserved for Open-ended Question 2.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper extracts exponential modes from zeros of an inverse Fourier covariance expression, uses covariance-density Laplace transforms to solve for coefficient matrices, and learns the excitation-graph support from those matrices.
The article studies Hawkes processes observed as fixed-width counts and states consistency and asymptotic normality for a Whittle spectral estimator under a moment condition.
The paper gives a nonasymptotic confidence set for maximum-likelihood Hawkes-network estimation using continuous-time martingale concentration.
The paper studies low-resolution discrete-time event sequences, identifies instantaneous-effect ambiguity, and proposes structural Hawkes processes with EM and sparse optimization.

The article develops multivariate binned-Hawkes MC-EM estimation via latent event-time proposals and handles exponential-kernel parameter estimation rather than proving finite-lag population injectivity.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv:1401.0903 corroborating preprint; cited IEEE version was not formula-inspected
source_verification_receipts.locator: Abstract; Section II-B discussion of Theorem 1
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The preprint establishes unique causal Wiener–Hopf recovery of the Hawkes kernel from second-order functional information and does not state a two-fixed-bin-lag inverse.

The article constructs a coarse-grained count-process approximation, derives its autocovariance/spectrum, proves a small-bin spectral approximation, and proposes second-order parameter estimation; it does not provide the proposed exact two-lag DAG inverse.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Add Koyama2025 to related work and state precisely that its coarse-grained model is an approximation with spectral/second-order estimation, whereas the proposed result is an exact finite-lag inverse for the original process.
Replace every DΦ Omega DΦᵀ occurrence by the derivative of the composite raw-moment-to-centered-moment-to-Phi map, and use that same composite Jacobian in the HAC and simultaneous-sign calibration.
Add primary-source locators for the main comparison claims, especially the exact Etesami covariance-spectrum/Laplace-transform steps and the Zhou aggregated-data identifiability theorem.
Define the one-lag fiber topology and formulate the boundary OEQ with a named loss, parameter metric, minimax class, and a focal adaptation modulus or frontier.

recommended_next_step: Revise the survey anchors and the centered-moment asymptotic map, then sharpen both OEQs into formally defined targets before advancing the exact-recovery core to Stage 0.
